# 0. 运行环境 / Environment

本项目从 `filtered_merge`、`filtered_region`、`Function_prediction` 现成结果出发，不重跑原始数据下载、质控和功能预测。高耗时结果已放在 `server_result/`，默认直接读取。

This project starts from the existing `filtered_merge`, `filtered_region` and `Function_prediction` results. It does not rerun raw-data download, filtering or functional prediction. Expensive numerical results are supplied in `server_result/` and reused by default.

首次使用请先阅读 [environment/README.md](environment/README.md)，按需手动安装依赖；普通 Knit 不会自动安装或更新软件。

Read [environment/README.md](environment/README.md) before the first run. Ordinary Knit does not install or update software.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = TRUE,
                      fig.align = "center", out.width = "100%")
Sys.setenv(SEED_PROJECT_ROOT = normalizePath(getwd(), winslash = "/"))
```

```{r install-environment, eval=FALSE}
# 首次安装：手动运行一次 / First-time setup: run manually once.
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("renv")
renv::restore(project = ".", prompt = FALSE)
```

```{r install-python, eval=FALSE}
# 地图依赖 / Map dependencies.
python <- Sys.getenv("SEED_PYTHON", unset = Sys.which("python"))
system2(python, c("-m", "pip", "install", "numpy", "pandas", "geopandas", "matplotlib", "shapely"))
```

```{r preflight}
# 运行前检查 / Preflight checks.
required <- c("data.table", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "tidyr", "ape", "vegan", "phytools",
              "ggtree", "ggtreeExtra", "patchwork", "cowplot", "gridExtra", "ggrepel",
              "ggpubr", "RColorBrewer", "metagenomeSeq", "ecodist", "cluster",
              "writexl", "jsonlite", "knitr", "rmarkdown")
missing <- required[!vapply(required, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(missing)) {
  stop("Missing R packages / 缺少 R 包: ", paste(missing, collapse = ", "),
       "\nRun the first-time setup chunk or see environment/README.md.", call. = FALSE)
}
python <- Sys.getenv("SEED_PYTHON", unset = Sys.which("python"))
if (!nzchar(python)) stop("Python 3 not found / 未找到 Python 3; set SEED_PYTHON.", call. = FALSE)
message("Preflight passed; threads capped at 16 / 运行前检查通过，线程上限 16")
```

运行选项 / Runtime options:

| 变量 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `SEED_THREADS` | 16 | 线程上限，最大 16 |
| `SEED_RECOMPUTE` | 空 | 空=复用检查点；`all` 或逗号分隔步骤名强制重算 |
| `ALLOW_SERVER_RECOMPUTE` | false | 允许本地执行服务器等价步骤 |
| `SEED_PYTHON` | `python` | 地图脚本解释器 |
